source: Cellar SPARQL (publications.europa.eu/webapi/rdf/sparql), three predicates, frozen as N-Triples by the collection session on 2026-09-09 (lot A1); node properties from lot A2

repeals.why: an official register of repeals is exhaustive for the acts it lists; targets absent from Cellar are in known_gaps

based_on.why: legal bases are declared unevenly (43 empty targets): a candidate's extra based_on is out_of_coverage, never false

coverage.covers: acts that take part in resource_legal_repeals|amends|based_on_resource_legal, as served on 2026-09-09
does_not_cover: acts whose text is not served

audit.method: facts read against the act's text by a human

world_laws.text: an act cannot repeal or amend an act whose date_document is later than its own
world_laws.cypher: MATCH p=(a:Act)-[r:REPEALS|AMENDS]->(b:Act) WHERE a.date_document_status = 'ok' AND b.date_document_status = 'ok' AND date(a.date_document) < date(b.date_document) RETURN p

world_laws.text: an act does not amend anything dated after its own end of validity
world_laws.cypher: MATCH p=(a:Act)-[r:AMENDS]->(b:Act) WHERE a.date_end_of_validity IS NOT NULL AND b.date_document_status = 'ok' AND date(b.date_document) > date(a.date_end_of_validity) RETURN p

world_laws.text: a legal basis is an act with a CELEX, never an empty identifier
world_laws.cypher: MATCH p=(a:Act)-[r:BASED_ON]->(b) WHERE (b.celex IS NULL OR b.celex = '') AND coalesce(b.gap, false) = false RETURN p

world_laws.text: an act's type label says what its CELEX says: 32019R1020 is a Regulation, 32019L1020 a Directive
world_laws.cypher: MATCH (a:Act) WHERE a.celex IS NOT NULL AND a.type_label IS NOT NULL AND NOT a:$label RETURN a

world_laws.text: two acts do not repeal each other: if A repeals B, B does not repeal A
world_laws.cypher: MATCH p1=(a:Act)-[r1:REPEALS]->(b:Act), p2=(b)-[r2:REPEALS]->(a) RETURN p1, p2

notes.rule: when a property has several values, the smallest is kept and the list is in <prop>_all
